headline: Anthropic expands Claude capabilities with new collaborative tools and code features
body: Anthropic released Claude Whiteboards, Claude Sheets, and Claude Data alongside expanded Claude Code functionality, marking a significant expansion of the AI assistant's collaborative and data processing features. For healthcare organizations, these tools directly impact clinical workflow integration by enabling real-time collaboration on patient data analysis, EHR documentation assistance, and complex clinical decision support across distributed teams. The addition of native data handling capabilities reduces friction in value-based care analytics and population health reporting. However, security concerns around Claude Code's GitHub exposure require healthcare IT teams to implement strict governance protocols before deploying these features in HIPAA-regulated environments. Healthcare consulting practices should assess these new capabilities against existing enterprise security policies and evaluate deployment timelines accordingly.
